name: The Court of the Seven-Headed Serpent

variants.name: Court of the Seven-Headed Serpent (base list)

specialRules.name: Seven Deadly Sins
specialRules.text: Before recruiting choose Wrath, Envy, Lust, Pride, Sloth, Gluttony or Greed; this sets the Goetic Powers available and the Desecrated Saint's aura. Use one of the Sin variants to build a list.

specialRules.name: Goetic Powers
specialRules.text: ELITE models can buy Goetic Powers up to the number on their entry. Abilities work like normal abilities; Spells are cast by paying BLOOD MARKERS (no Success Roll), taken from any non-BLACK GRAIL, non-DEMONIC models anywhere, friend or foe. A model cannot cast the same spell twice per Activation; some need a Cast Spell ACTION.

specialRules.name: Command
specialRules.text: Must include a Praetor or a Sorcerer, or both. Fallen.

models.name: Praetor
models.kitRule: any Court kit; up to 2 Goetic Powers (1 if dedicated to Wrath)

abilities.name: Command
abilities.text: A Court warband must include a Praetor or a Sorcerer (or both).

models.name: Sorcerer
models.kitRule: any Court kit except Ranged Weapons and Grenades; up to 3 Goetic Powers plus free Blessing of the Serpent Moon

abilities.name: Command
abilities.text: A Court warband must include a Praetor or a Sorcerer (or both).

models.name: Hunter of the Left-Hand Path
models.kitRule: always holds the Bow of Lethe in one hand; any Court kit except 2-Handed Weapons; no other Goetic Powers

models.name: Hell Knight
models.kitRule: always wears Infernal Iron Armour (in profile); any Court kit except Armour; 1 Goetic Power besides the free Blood Magic

models.name: Wretched
models.kitRule: only Court kit costing 10 ducats or less per item; must carry at least 1 Weapon; must be outnumbered by DEMONIC models

abilities.name: Law of Hell
abilities.text: If its attack takes an ELITE enemy Out of Action, it is freed and removed from the game (and roster).

abilities.name: Poison Stingers
abilities.text: Melee Attacks without a weapon with CLEAVE 2 and SHRAPNEL.

models.name: Yoke Fiend
models.kitRule: 1 Ranged Weapon costing 30 ducats or less; any other Court kit except Ranged Weapons

abilities.name: Hateful
abilities.text: On Activation, if not in melee and a visible non-BLACK GRAIL, non-DEMONIC enemy is within 12", it must Charge the closest such enemy (standing up first if Down).

abilities.name: Torturer
abilities.text: May make a Melee Attack against a friendly non-DEMONIC model (then no further attacks that Activation).

models.name: Desecrated Saint
models.kitRule: up to three 1-Handed Melee Weapons, or two 1-Handed and one 2-Handed Melee Weapon; nothing else

abilities.name: Annihilator
abilities.text: One Fight ACTION per Activation with each Melee Weapon it carries.

abilities.name: Demonic Aura
abilities.text: Aura set by the warband's Sin (see the Sin variant).

uniqueKit.name: Arquebus
uniqueKit.text: Batter: can also be used as a 2-Handed Melee Weapon.

uniqueKit.name: Bow of Lethe
uniqueKit.text: Hunter only, always carried. Before each Injury Roll choose +2 INJURY DICE or IGNORE ARMOUR.

uniqueKit.name: Crown of Hellfire
uniqueKit.text: Searing Flames: when the wearer ends an Activation, 1 BLOOD MARKER on each enemy within 1" (not NEGATE FIRE).

uniqueKit.name: Headtaker
uniqueKit.text: Ambush Weapon: +2 INJURY MODIFIER if the target has not Activated yet this Turn.

uniqueKit.name: Infernal Iron Armour
uniqueKit.text: Hell Knights only.

uniqueKit.name: Ophidian Rifle
uniqueKit.text: Unnatural Inversion: Cover and Long Range each give +1 DICE instead of -1 DICE.

sim.cond: target in Cover or at Long Range (+1 each instead of -1)

uniqueKit.name: Restraining Muzzle
uniqueKit.text: Brought to Heel: Yoke Fiend gets +1 DICE on Ranged Attacks and ignores Hateful.

uniqueKit.name: Torture Instrument
uniqueKit.text: Agonising Injuries: Injury Roll uses 1D6 (Bloodbath 2D6) and BLOOD MARKERS caused are doubled; +/-INJURY DICE pick the single best/worst die.

uniqueKit.name: Burning Inferno
uniqueKit.text: Cast Spell ACTION: 36" Ranged Attack with BLAST (radius = BLOOD MARKERS paid), FIRE and SCATTER; a hit or scatter onto a model gives that Injury Roll IGNORE ARMOUR.

sim.injury: BLAST 1-3 (markers paid), FIRE, SCATTER; IGNORE ARMOUR on the model hit

uniqueKit.name: Slavemaster
uniqueKit.text: Cast Spell ACTION: a Yoke Fiend within 18" immediately kills itself, fights, moves (no Charge/Retreat) or shoots; it can still Activate normally.

uniqueKit.name: Blessing of the Serpent Moon
uniqueKit.text: Cast before an Injury Roll against the Sorcerer: -1 INJURY MODIFIER per 2 BLOOD MARKERS paid (2/4/6). Free for Sorcerers.

uniqueKit.name: Blood Magic
uniqueKit.text: Cast before the Hell Knight's Injury Rolls for an attack: +1 INJURY DICE to all of them. Free for Hell Knights.

uniqueKit.name: Left-Hand Path
uniqueKit.text: When moving into contact with terrain, vanish and reappear touching another terrain piece more than 1" from enemies (closer to the target if charging); repeatable at cost each time.

uniqueKit.name: Oracle Beast Cloak
uniqueKit.text: Once per Turn after an Injury Roll on the Hunter, change it to No Effect.

uniqueKit.name: Shadow-walker
uniqueKit.text: Cast before Retreating: enemies get no Melee Attack on the Hunter.

variants.name: Court of the Seven-Headed Serpent - Wrath
variants.changes: Warband dedicated to Wrath: unlocks the Wrath Goetic Powers and gives the Desecrated Saint the Aura of Wrath. Praetors may have only 1 Goetic Power.

specialRules.name: Aura of Wrath
specialRules.text: Friendly models within 8" (and the Saint) get +1 DICE to Melee Attacks and Dash Risky Success Rolls.

uniqueKit.name: Blind Rage

uniqueKit.name: Charge of Hatred
uniqueKit.text: Charges as if Movement were 12" with no D6 Charge Bonus; charging anything but the closest visible enemy needs a Risky Success Roll first (failure ends the Activation).

sim.cond: charge reach fixed at 12", no D6

uniqueKit.name: Lesser Mark of Cain
uniqueKit.text: The model has -1 INJURY DICE (Injury Rolls against it are worse).

uniqueKit.text: Cast Spell ACTION (ends the caster's Activation): the next enemy model to Activate must first Move/Charge/Retreat to end as close as possible to the caster, and cannot attack the caster that Turn.

uniqueKit.name: Exquisite Pain

lists.name: The Red Hunt of Satan
lists.style: Fast melee tide: Praetor with Charge of Hatred and two raging Hell Knights crash in under the Desecrated Saint's Aura of Wrath while Yoke Fiends and Wretched soak fire.

models.label: Hell Knight of the Red Banner
Hell Knight of the Black Banner

lists.name: Choir of the Fallen Star
lists.style: Spell battery: Sorcerer and Praetor hurl Burning Inferno and Light of Samael fuelled by blood, the Hunter stalks through terrain, Pit Locusts and a Warlock harvest markers; Proud Defiance ignores morale.

lists.name: Mammon's Toll-Collectors
lists.style: Gunline: Serpent Assault Guns and an Ophidian Rifle on armoured demons, muzzled Yoke Fiends shooting straight, Black Heart for key rolls and a Scripture Guardian anchoring the objective.
